title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: One theme per practice
hook: What is today's practice about, in one word?
intro: Practice has throwing, hitting, fielding, and a scrimmage.
Kids leave not sure what they worked on.
statement: One theme gives every drill a reason.
q1: Do you build each practice around one skill —
q2: or cover a little of everything each time?
q3: Could your players name today's theme?
t1: Both can work. But kids improve faster
t2: when every drill points the same way.
cta: Coaches — do your practices have a theme?
ctaLines: Fielding day. Base-running day. Throwing accuracy.
One theme or a full menu?
ctaPrompt: Share your planning habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What is today's practice about, in one word?
Practice has throwing, hitting, fielding, and a scrimmage. Kids leave not sure what they worked on.
One theme gives every drill a reason.
One theme or a bit of everything. There is no perfect answer.
Do your practices have a theme? Share your habit in the comments.
